title: Ɔman a Ɛtia Abɔde Nhyehyɛe no
intro: Wɔ ɔmantam bi a n’asɛm no hyia wɔ mfe no mu no, na ɔmanfo bi traa ase wɔ atuatew a ɛda adi pefee mu tiaa ahotew ho mmara ahorow. Na wɔn nneyɛe no yɛ nea ebi mmae da araa ma wɔkae wɔn sɛ kɔkɔbɔ ma adesamma nyinaa. Henanom ne akra yi, na nkrabea bɛn na ɛtoo wɔn?
clues: Ná yɛte asase bi a ɛnam ɔkwan bi a akwantufo taa fa so so, nanso yɛmaa wɔn akwantu no yɛɛ nea asiane wom.
Yɛyɛɛ ahohwibra a ɛte saa a obiara nni wiase ahorow no mu da.
Ɔbɔfo bi a ofi yɛn mu frɛɛ yɛn sɛ yennyae yɛn akwan, nanso yɛpow no na sɛ ɔka nokware a, yɛhwehwɛɛ asotwe no.
Sɛ ahɔho a wɔn ho yɛ fɛ ba yɛn kurow no mu a, na yɛhwehwɛ sɛ yɛbɛtow ahyɛ wɔn so, a na yennim sɛ wɔyɛ ɔsɛe abɔfo.
Wɔbɔɔ yɛn kɔkɔ sɛ sɛ yɛannyae asotwe a ɛyɛ hu ho, nanso yedii kɔkɔbɔ no ho fɛw na yɛkɔɔ so traa yɛn bɔne mu.
Abo osu bi fi soro tɔe guu yɛn so, na yɛn afie danee, na annyaw biribiara gye sɛnkyerɛnne biara maa wɔn a wosusuw nneɛma ho no.

Wosii abantenten a ɛkorɔn de twaa ɔsoro mpoa
trial.answer: Ɔyɛɛ ɔbrasɛe a ebi mmae da na osiw akwan

arabic: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient." (29:34)
